audience: foundation board and donors; drives tranche disbursement decisions

terminology.attended: Present at a session. Supported by an attendance record only.
terminology.completed: Finished the full program AND passed the end-of-program assessment (ASSESS form). Attendance alone is NOT completion.
terminology.trained: Ambiguous. Do not use in a claim. Resolve to 'attended' or 'completed' depending on the evidence.

rules.text: Every numeric claim must state its unit, its period, and at least one evidence record. A number without all three is unsupported.
A report stays draft until the officer approves it. Nothing here approves itself.
Never infer an outcome from participation alone. Attendance does not imply completion, learning, or employment.
Report participation as 'attended'. Do not report 'completed' unless the end-of-program assessment (ASSESS) record is present for that person or cohort.

status_definitions.supported: Backed by at least one evidence record; consistent across sources; satisfies R1.
status_definitions.conflicting: Two or more sources give different values for the same fact.
status_definitions.unsupported: No evidence record backs it, or it violates a rule (e.g. completion without ASSESS).
status_definitions.uncertain: Partial evidence; cannot be confirmed or denied yet.
